fact: Ley Núm. 5/2026 of April 2026 creates a Registro Único Social (RUS) within the Instituto de Protección Social, to hold data on actual and potential beneficiaries of public programmes, drawing on other public and private bodies, and to be available to the national statistics institute, local entities and institutions administering social programmes.
title: Ley Núm. 5/2026, Reguladora del Sistema de Protección Social en la República de Guinea Ecuatorial
